Class AnalyticsCacheService

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.handlers.AnalyticsCacheService
@Service public class AnalyticsCacheService extends Object
In-memory cache for analytics DoublyLinkedList datasets, shared by all users of the web application and scoped per user.

The web server handles many users at once, so a single shared map would leak one user's listening data into another user's response. Entries are therefore keyed by the composite key userId + ":" + key, and invalidateUser(Long) drops every entry that belongs to one user.

The server also runs for days, so entries expire. Each cached value stores the time it was loaded, and an entry older than TTL_MILLIS is reloaded on the next request. Expired entries are swept from the map on each cache miss so memory stays bounded by the live entries.

The map is a ConcurrentHashMap because request threads read and write it concurrently. Two requests that miss at the same moment may both run the loader; the last write wins, which is harmless because both loaders return the same data.

Cache invalidation:

  • Call invalidateUser(Long) after that user's playback history changes (for example after a song is played).
  • Call invalidate(String) to drop one unscoped key, or invalidateAll() to clear everything, for example after a bulk import.

Time Complexity: O(1) average per get/put (ConcurrentHashMap). A miss also sweeps expired entries, which is O(n) where n = cached entries.

Space Complexity: O(n) where n = live cached entries across all users.

  • Method Details

    • getOrLoad

      public <T> DoublyLinkedList<T> getOrLoad(Long userId, String key, Supplier<DoublyLinkedList<T>> loader)
      Returns the cached list for one user and key, or loads it via loader when there is no entry or the entry is older than 60 seconds.

      The entry is stored under the composite key userId + ":" + key, so two users never share a cached value even when they use the same key.

      Time Complexity: O(1) on a fresh hit; O(n) on a miss (the loader plus the expiry sweep)

      Space Complexity: O(n) on a miss, where n = size of the loaded list

      Type Parameters:
      T - element type stored in the list
      Parameters:
      userId - the owner of the cached data
      key - cache key within the user's scope (e.g. "history", "topSongs", "topAlbums", "topArtists")
      loader - supplier that builds the full list; only called on a miss or after expiry
      Returns:
      the cached or freshly loaded list

    • getOrLoad

      public <T> DoublyLinkedList<T> getOrLoad(String key, Supplier<DoublyLinkedList<T>> loader)
      Returns the cached list for an unscoped key, or loads it via loader when there is no entry or the entry is older than 60 seconds.

      Prefer getOrLoad(Long, String, Supplier) for user data, so that entries are scoped per user.

      Time Complexity: O(1) on a fresh hit; O(n) on a miss (the loader plus the expiry sweep)

      Space Complexity: O(n) on a miss, where n = size of the loaded list

      Type Parameters:
      T - element type stored in the list
      Parameters:
      key - cache key (used as-is, without a user prefix)
      loader - supplier that builds the full list; only called on a miss or after expiry
      Returns:
      the cached or freshly loaded list

    • invalidateUser

      public void invalidateUser(Long userId)
      Removes every cached entry that belongs to one user. The next getOrLoad(Long, String, Supplier) call for that user reloads from the database.

      Time Complexity: O(n) where n = cached entries across all users

      Space Complexity: O(1)

      Parameters:
      userId - the user whose entries should be dropped

    • invalidate

      public void invalidate(String key)
      Removes a single unscoped key from the cache. The next call to getOrLoad(String, Supplier) for this key reloads from the database.

      Time Complexity: O(1) average

      Space Complexity: O(1)

      Parameters:
      key - cache key to evict

    • invalidateAll

      public void invalidateAll()
      Clears the entire cache, for every user. Call this after a bulk import.

      Time Complexity: O(n) where n = cached entries

      Space Complexity: O(1)
